title: Algeria exports 22,000t of white cement to Guatemala
summary: Algeria exports 22,000t of white cement to Guatemala
body_markdown:
**Algeria:** A shipment of 22,000t of white cement was loaded at the port of Annaba as part of an export operation to Guatemala, according to a statement by the Annaba port company.


The company Biskria Ciment shipped the product from Berth 9 at the port.
